info.name: Integration Hub Middlelayer
info.description: End-to-end smoke-test collection for the Integration Hub Middlelayer REST API. Organized into one folder per resource (Dashboard, Mandators, Companies, Interfaces, Mapping Templates, Configuration Templates, Company Mappings, Company Configurations) plus a final Cleanup folder. Requests are chained via collection variables captured from prior responses (mandatorId, companyId, interfaceId, ...), so running the whole collection top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner exercises create -> read -> update -> resolve/override -> delete across the full object graph.
